posts.body:
As a long distance grandma, I'd like to sign up to a baby site that would keep me in touch with one if my grandchildrens development stages so I can know appropriate gifts etc to buy.

Which site should I sign up to?

Many thanks.

posts.body: I agree with babycentre, but bounty and Emma's diary are also good. But, I'd also talk to the parents, babies all develop at different rates, and some in different areas... Like our son, he is quite in line with everything, but 6months being in supermarket clothes!! (Very odd!!)
